hero.heading: The work, and the numbers behind it.
hero.lead: Every engagement below is measured against a single agreed metric before we start. Here's what happened after.

feature.heading: Precision at scale across four markets
feature.body: A replatform alone wouldn't have moved the number. We paired the Shopify Plus build with a custom inventory middleware layer and a Klaviyo flow architecture that now accounts for 38% of total revenue.

cases.name: Aura Labs
cases.title: A legacy migration that paid for itself in one quarter
cases.body: We moved Aura Labs off a heavily customized legacy stack onto Shopify Plus, built a middleware layer to sync inventory in real time across four markets, and rebuilt the Klaviyo flow structure from scratch.

cases.name: Veloce
cases.title: Turning a discount-dependent list into a retention engine
cases.body: Veloce was sending eight campaigns a week and training customers to wait for promos. We rebuilt segmentation around predicted lifetime value, cut send volume by a third, and let behavioral flows carry the load.

cases.name: Northbound Supply
cases.title: Six seconds to under two, and the checkout followed
cases.body: An app-bloated theme was costing Northbound conversions on mobile. We audited every script, rebuilt the critical rendering path, and ran a six-month testing program against PDP and checkout.

cta.heading: Want results like these?
cta.body: We scope every project against one metric you actually care about.
